scenario.label_zh: 预约暖气流动异常检查
scenario.goal_zh: 说明暖气不热及阀门情况并约定检查时间，不声称已经维修

context_zh: 租客玛雅打电话向维修协调员说明暖气问题。
author: author-phase05-c

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: The heating is on, but the radiator in my bedroom stays cold.

sentences.speaker: Owen
sentences.text: Are the radiators in the other rooms warm?

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: Yes. Water does not seem to flow through this one, though I cannot tell why.

sentences.speaker: Owen
sentences.text: Has anyone adjusted its valve recently?

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: I tried turning it gently, but it would not move. I did not want to force it.

sentences.speaker: Owen
sentences.text: Good. Leave it as it is until our technician checks it.

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: Can I have an immediate appointment? I work from home today.

sentences.speaker: Owen
sentences.text: Nothing is available this morning, but the technician can come at three.

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: Three works. I will be here to let them in.
